events.description: A hand holding a glass kettle enters the frame from the right side
Water is poured from the glass kettle into the pink cup on the platform
The red tomato rolls off the left side of the platform
A person looks through the archway of panel 1, with eyes moving upward and around
The person continues looking through panel 1 archway with eyes moving side to side
The person's mouth opens and closes while looking through the archway of panel 1
The camera shifts focus to show panels 2 and 3 more clearly, with the person no longer visible through the archway
A title card with the text "BEHIND THE SCENES" appears over footage showing the mechanical setup with a banana, red ball, and ramp structure
A red ball rolls down an orange ramp structure on the table
The red ball collides with a yellow banana, causing the banana to move
A yellow ball rolls into the scene from the right side of the table
Blue dominoes fall in sequence after being triggered by the rolling balls
The camera pans to reveal the full mechanical setup behind the pink panels, showing how the structures are connected and how balls move through the system
The video shows a behind-the-scenes view of a stop-motion animation setup with a table containing a yellow character, blue robot, green panels, and other small objects
The scene transitions to a pink structure with a person's face visible through the central archway, showing a pink cup with a tea bag on a small wooden structure
A hand places a red ball on a small wooden structure through the right archway labeled '4'
The red ball moves from the wooden structure through the archway onto the table surface
The red ball rolls from the archway area toward the yellow banana on the table
A hand manipulates a yellow string that is attached to a tea bag above the pink cup
The yellow string lifts the tea bag up and out of the pink cup
A hand reaches through the central archway and lifts the pink cup from its wooden stand
The pink cup is moved from its original position on the wooden stand to a new position on the table
The person drinks from the pink cup while visible through the central archway
person visible through the arched opening speaks with changing mouth positions
